title: Phrasal verbs 4
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. Node status checked first: `coming`. The fourth phrasal unit on the path, so 108 are already taught — b1_phrasal_1 (36), b1_phrasal_2 (36) and leaf_phrasal_3_b2 (36, drafted earlier today on this lane). The candidate list was built against all three and all 44 came back clean, which is the sweep confirming the method rather than rescuing it. Grouped by job again, and the three jobs are deliberately different from Phrasal verbs 3's: STARTING AND PUSHING ON (get down to, get round to, set about, step up, push for, work on, run through, look over, bring forward, call off), GIVING WAY OR HOLDING FIRM (give in, hold back, get out of, make do, settle for, pass up, go along with, keep to, stand by, step in) — a cluster no earlier unit has, and the one that carries most of the social weight — and WHAT THINGS DO BY THEMSELVES (wear off, wear out, come off, give off), plus the people ones (pick on, let off, turn to, see through). USE PROMPTS ARE ALL BASE FORM, the rule learned the hard way in Phrasal verbs 3: check_rewrite swaps in the lemma verbatim, so any inflected answer — a past tense, a third-person -s — can never reconstruct. Every one of the twelve Use items sits after a modal, an imperative or *to* for that reason. C57 card 0 recaps Phrasal verbs 1 to 3.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Three phrasal units already stand behind this one — a hundred and eight of them, from turn on and throw away up to figure out, keep up with and carry out. Those come back in this unit's sentences. What is new here is mostly about **people**: starting something and pushing it on, and the harder one — giving way, or refusing to.
cards.note_cz: Za touhle lekcí stojí tři lekce frázových sloves — sto osm, od turn on a throw away až po figure out, keep up with a carry out. Vracejí se ve větách. Nové je tu hlavně o **lidech**: začít něco a tlačit to dál, a to těžší — ustoupit, nebo neustoupit.

cards.title: Giving way, or holding firm
cards.title_cz: Ustoupit, nebo si stát za svým

cards.title: Four ways of not fighting
points: These four all mean roughly *I stopped pushing* — and they are not the same.
The difference is whether you were beaten, whether you agreed, and whether you wanted it.

rows: you were losing, and you stopped
you did not mind either way
you wanted more and took less
